name: Commitments
description: Extracts commitments and deadlines from recent mail with source quotes, flags what needs action, and can check daily on a schedule.
author: Mail Triage

horizon_days.description: how many days ahead count as due soon (default 14)

max_messages.description: candidate messages to read for extraction (default 20)

sent_folder.description: Sent folder name for promise detection (blank = try common names)

tools.name: extract_commitments
tools.description: List commitments and deadlines from recent mail: what the user still owes, what has a due date, and anything the user may have promised. Use when asked 'what do I need to do', 'what is due', or about outstanding tasks and deadlines.
